about_meta_description: Leora Events helps Ethiopian couples plan their wedding and find trusted vendors in one place.
about_title: Ethiopia's weddings, planned with heart and technology.
about_lead: Leora Events was built by a small team in Addis Ababa who believe planning a wedding should feel joyful, not overwhelming — whether you're inviting 50 guests or 500.
about_why_body: Wedding planning in Ethiopia has always relied on word of mouth, endless phone calls, and spreadsheets passed between family members. We started Leora Events to bring that same trusted, community feel online — with real vendor availability, transparent pricing, and tools that keep budgets and guest lists organized in one place.
about_value1_body: Vendor pricing, availability, and reviews are visible upfront — no hidden fees or surprise quotes.
about_value2_body: From local payment methods to multi-day celebration planning, every feature is designed around how weddings actually happen here.
about_value3_title: A platform vendors can grow on.
about_value3_body: Small businesses get the same visibility tools as larger ones, with fair, flexible pricing plans.

home_faq_q1: Is Leora free to use for couples?
home_faq_a1: Yes. Browsing the marketplace, planning your budget and building your guest list are all free for couples.
home_faq_a2: Every vendor is reviewed by our team before their listing goes live, and couples can only review vendors they actually booked.
home_faq_q3: Can I plan multiple events under one wedding?
home_faq_a3: Yes — engagement, Melse, ceremony and reception can all live under a single budget and guest list.
home_faq_q4: Does Leora work outside Addis Ababa?
home_faq_a4: Yes. Vendors from any city can list on Leora, and the directory grows as more join.
